title: Faithfully flat weakly étale algebras over a w-contractible ring split
statement:
Let $D$ be w-contractible and let $D\to E$ be faithfully flat and weakly étale. Then there
is a $D$-algebra map $E\to D$, i.e. $\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}D$ has a
section.

proof.text: Apply [thm-weil-pbc-weak-etale-refinement] to $A=D$ and $B=E$. The weakly étale hypothesis is exactly that required by [def-weil-pbc-weak-etale-refinement]. Its constructed ring $E'$ has its specified $E$-algebra map $E\to E'$, which is faithfully flat and ind-étale, and the composite $D\to E'$ is ind-étale.

To check faithful flatness of $D\to E'$, let $C$ be any three-term complex of $D$-modules with composite zero. By [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], exactness of $C$ is equivalent to exactness of $E\otimes_D C$, and this is equivalent to exactness of $E'\otimes_E(E\otimes_D C)$, since both given maps are faithfully flat. The natural isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-cancel-base-change], with $R=D$, $S=E$, $M=E'$, identify the latter complex, including its differentials, with $E'\otimes_D C$. Explicitly, write $a,b$ for the differentials of the twice-tensored complex and $a',b'$ for those of $E'\otimes_D C$, and write $c_i$ for the isomorphism in degree $i$. Naturality gives $c_2a=a'c_1$ and $c_3b=b'c_2$. Since the $c_i$ are bijective, $c_2(\operatorname{im}a)=\operatorname{im}a'$ and $c_2(\ker b)=\ker b'$, so either complex is exact if and only if the other is. The same definition therefore says that $D\to E'$ is faithfully flat.

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-wc-rings-retraction] to the w-contractible ring $D$ and the faithfully flat ind-étale $D$-algebra $E'$. It gives a $D$-algebra retraction $\rho:E'\to D$ whose composite with $D\to E'$ is $\operatorname{id}_D$.

The composite $E\to E'\xrightarrow{\rho}D$ is a $D$-algebra map. It induces $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}E$, and the retraction identity makes this map a section of $\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}D$.

theorem exists_retraction_of_wlocal_geometric_criterion
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsWLocalRing R]
    [ExtremallyDisconnected (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum R))]
    (hstrict : ∀ (m : Ideal R) [m.IsMaximal],
      IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime m))
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] (f : R →+* B)
    (hfaithful : f.FaithfullyFlat) (hweak : f.WeaklyEtale) :
    ∃ r : B →+* R, r.comp f = RingHom.id R
lean.note: The existing theorem spells out exactly IsWContractibleRing: IsWLocalRing, extremal disconnectedness of ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum R), and strictly henselian localizations at every maximal ideal. Its retraction identity is precisely the algebra-map condition and equivalently the affine section condition.
